, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a factual error by claiming there was a “first combined DTM/ITC season” in 1997 (DTM/ITC ended in 1996 and DTM was relaunched in 2000). This incorrect timeline skewed the reasoning toward ITC and away from correctly identifying the series Franchitti competed in after the Affalterbach-based team contracted him, and it was not verified with authoritative sources.
